Çarşamba günü açıklanan bulgular, Visa, Mastercard, Stripe ve diğer ödeme devlerinin x402 protokolünü desteklemesi ve Coinbase'in ticari müşterilerin yapay zeka aracılarından ödeme kabul etmesine izin vermesiyle geldi. Faaliyetlerin çoğu, Coinbase tarafından geliştirilen ve AI temsilcilerinin kripto kullanarak dijital hizmetler için otomatik olarak ödeme yapmasına olanak tanıyan bir ödeme protokolü olan x402 üzerinden yürütülüyor. items.article_context_en: Major payment networks backed the x402 protocol as AI agents increasingly deploy crypto rails for compute, data, and security services. Artificial intelligence (AI) agents are no longer just talking to each other. They are paying for services, buying data and even purchasing access to tokens the AI models, with more than 138 million transactions recorded through the x402 protocol on Coinbase’s Base blockchain, according to a Chainalysis’ Inside North America's $3 trillion crypto economy: Agentic commerce accelerates report. The United States dominates this emerging market. U.S.linked wallets accounted for 88.1% of the geographically identified payments for AI model inference, compared with just 0.1% for Chinese-linked wallets, the blockchain analytics firm found. "One possible explanation is that Chinese developers are more inclined to use open-weight models such as DeepSeek and Qwen, reducing their need to purchase metered inference services," Eric Jardine, Chainalysis' head of research, told CoinDesk. The findings, released Wednesday, come as Visa, Mastercard, Stripe and other payments giants have backed the x402 protocol, while Coinbase has begun allowing business customers to accept payments from AI agents. Yat Siu, co-founder and chairman of Animoca Brands, recently told CoinDesk that over the next few years he estimates up to 100 billion AI agents will be transacting on the internet and they will be using crypto. And crypto’s next billion users might be AI agents paying with stablecoins. “Stablecoins are particularly well suited to the kinds of transactions we expect AI agents to make at first,” Stephanie Cohen, Cloudflare’s chief strategy officer, told CoinDesk. Unlike traditional card payments, stablecoins can handle transactions worth fractions of a cent, allowing AI agents to buy data, computing power and other services without human intervention. The new Chainalysis figures offer evidence of growing use of those payment systems, although transaction counts alone do not establish how much represents genuine commercial demand. Much of the activity runs through x402, a payments protocol incubated by Coinbase that allows AI agents to pay automatically for digital services using crypto. More than 87% of x402 payments analyzed by Chainalysis were worth between one-hundredth of a cent and 10 cents, making them too small to process economically through traditional credit card networks.

items.article_context_en: The asset manager's crypto assets surged 63% to $79.6 billion as investors returned, but holdings remain 23% below year-ago levels. BlackRock's crypto funds had a much better third quarter than first half of the year but they still have a long way to go to recover the assets lost during the broader crypto market downturn. The asset manager reported $79.6 billion in digital assets under management at the end of September, a 63% jump from $48.8 billion at the end of June, according to its third-quarter earnings report released Wednesday. Investors added $7.9 billion to BlackRock's digital asset products during the quarter, more than making up for the roughly $2.2 billion they withdrew during the first six months of 2026. The reversal came as crypto markets recovered from a slump earlier this year. Bitcoin BTC$81,499.86 and other cryptocurrencies had faced pressure during the first half of the year, weighing on the value of funds that hold them. The third-quarter recovery gave those funds a lift, while renewed investor demand added to their assets. Rising crypto prices did most of the heavy lifting. Of the $30.8 billion BlackRock added in digital assets during the quarter, $22.9 billion came from market gains, while investors contributed another $7.9 billion. Even after the rebound, BlackRock's crypto holdings remain 23% below the nearly $104 billion it managed a year ago. That gap isn't the result of investors abandoning its products. Over the past 12 months, BlackRock's digital asset funds attracted $6.3 billion in net new money. But declines in the market value of those assets erased $30.6 billion over the same period. The figures offer a reminder of how much BlackRock's crypto business depends on the price of the assets its funds hold, even as investors continue to put money into them.

items.article_context: Saldo Bank'ın devralınması, Payward'ı düzenleyici onay bekleyen bir Avrupa bankası satın alan ilk kripto ana şirketi haline getiriyor. Kripto borsası Kraken'in ana şirketi Payward, Litvanya merkezli Saldo Bank'ı açıklanmayan bir miktar karşılığında satın almayı kabul ettiğini ve kripto ticaretinin ötesinde geleneksel finansal hizmetlere doğru genişlerken ona Avrupa Birliği (AB) bankacılık lisansı verdiğini söyledi. Financial Times raporuna göre, kripto firmaları geleneksel borç verenlerle giderek daha fazla rekabet ederken, satın alma Payward'ı Avrupa'da banka satın alan ilk kripto şirketi yapacak. Payward, satın alma anlaşmasının tutarı hakkında daha fazla ayrıntı için CoinDesk'in talebine hemen yanıt vermedi. The Banks'e göre Saldo Bank'ın toplam aktifleri 2025 yılı sonunda bir önceki yıla göre %22,7 artışla 163,9 milyon Euro'ya (180 milyon $) ulaştı. CoinDesk'in Temmuz ayında bildirdiğine göre Kraken, Litvanya'da bankacılık lisansı arıyordu. ABD'de Payward, ulusal güven bankası sözleşmesi için başvuruda bulunurken, bankacılık kolu Federal Rezerv'in ödeme sistemine sınırlı erişim sağladı. Payward'ın eş CEO'su Arjun Sethi, "Denetlenen bir AB bankası, Avrupalı ​​müşterilerimize birincil bir finans kurumunun yapması gerektiği gibi hizmet etmemizi sağlayan parçadır: varlıkları tutabileceğimiz, serbestçe taşıyabileceğimiz ve çalıştırabileceğimiz tek bir yer" dedi. Anlaşma, Payward'ın AB müşterilerine faizli banka mevduatları, krediler, kart hizmetleri ve euro ödemeleri sunmasına olanak tanıyor. Saldo Bank, Litvanya, Finlandiya, İsveç ve Almanya'da lisanslıdır ve Hollanda'da faaliyet göstermek üzere pasaporta sahiptir. Mevduat, tüketici ve işletme kredileri ve ödeme hizmetleri sunmaktadır. Payward, bankacılık sektörünün halihazırda 2 milyar dolardan fazla kredi sağladığını ve Federal Reserve'ün sınırlı amaçlı ana hesabına ve İrlanda'da elektronik para kuruluşu lisansına sahip olduğunu söyledi. Anlaşma düzenleyici onayına tabi olmaya devam edecek ve 2027 yılında tamamlanması bekleniyor. Çeşitlendirilmiş RWA stablecoin'leri, kripto finansmanı ~%4'e sıkışırken gerçek krediden %5-7 getiri sağlıyor.

items.article_context_en: The takeover of Saldo Bank makes Payward the first crypto parent company to acquire a European bank, pending regulatory approval. Payward, the parent company of crypto exchange Kraken, said it agreed to acquire Lithuania-based Saldo Bank for an undisclosed amount, giving it a European Union (EU) banking license as it expands beyond crypto trading into traditional financial services. The acquisition will make Payward the first crypto firm to buy a bank in Europe, according to a Financial Times report, as crypto firms increasingly compete with traditional lenders. Payward did not immediately respond to a CoinDesk request for more details on the amount of the acquisition deal. Saldo Bank had 163.9 million euros ($180 million) in total assets at the end of 2025, up 22.7% from a year earlier, according to The Banks. Kraken had been seeking a banking license in Lithuania, CoinDesk reported in July. In the U.S., Payward has applied for a national trust bank charter, while its banking arm secured limited access to the Federal Reserve's payment system. "A regulated EU bank is the piece that lets us serve European clients the way a primary financial institution should: one place to hold assets, move them freely, and put them to work," said Arjun Sethi, Payward's co-CEO. The deal allows Payward to offer EU customers interest-bearing bank deposits, loans, card services and euro payments. Saldo Bank is licensed in Lithuania, Finland, Sweden and Germany, and holds a passport to operate in the Netherlands. It offers deposits, consumer and business loans and payment services. Payward said its banking business has already originated more than $2 billion in loans and holds a Federal Reserve limited-purpose master account and an electronic money institution license in Ireland. The deal remains subject to regulatory approval and is expected to close in 2027. Diversified RWA stablecoins sustain 5-7% yield from real credit as crypto funding compresses to ~4%.

Lee, son zamanlarda yaşanan satışların Bitcoin'deki kaldıracı azalttığını ancak piyasanın riskli bahislerini tam olarak ortadan kaldırmamış olabileceğini söyledi. Başka bir deyişle, tüccarlar hala önemli kaldıraçlı pozisyonlar taşıyor olabilir; bu da, getirilerin artması ve faiz indirimi beklentilerinin geri çekilmesi durumunda Bitcoin'i başka bir zorunlu satış kademesine karşı savunmasız hale getirebilir. Moon Pursuit Capital Ahuja'nın kurucusu ve yönetici ortağı Utkarsh Ahuja, yatırımcıların Fed'in politikayı piyasaların istediği kadar hızlı bir şekilde gevşetebileceği varsayımı konusunda dikkatli olmaları gerektiğini söyledi. Analistler, TÜFE'nin ötesinde, risk iştahının ve Bitcoin'in bundan sonra nereye gidebileceğine dair daha fazla ipucu bulmak için ETF akışlarını ve petrol fiyatındaki dalgalanmaları da izliyor. Grafik, Nymex'te listelenen WTI ham vadeli kontratlarının fiyatlarındaki günlük dalgalanmaları gösteriyor. Petrol Temmuz'un en düşük seviyelerinden yükselen yükseliş trend çizgisinden sıçradı ve daha geniş bir yükseliş yörüngesini güçlendirdi. Yüksek tarafta, psikolojik seviye olan 100 dolar ve 15 Eylül'ün en yüksek seviyesi olan 106,75 dolar izlenecek önemli rakamlar. Bu seviyelere doğru bir yükseliş enflasyon endişelerini artırabilir ve potansiyel olarak riskli varlıklar üzerinde baskı yaratabilir.

items.article_context_en: Economists surveyed by Dow Jones estimated September’s consumer price index rose 0.6% month-on-month and 3.6% year-on-year. Core CPI, which excludes volatile food and energy prices, is forecast to increase 0.2% from August and 2.5% annually. The numbers are widely watched for cues on how the Federal Reserve might respond with interest rates. For bitcoin, the focus will be less on the headline number alone and more on how the report reshapes Fed interest-rate policy expectations. Lee said a recent selloff has reduced leverage in bitcoin, but may not have fully cleared the market’s riskier bets. In other words, traders may still be carrying substantial leveraged positions, which makes bitcoin vulnerable to another cascade of forced selling if yields rise and rate-cut expectations retreat. Utkarsh Ahuja, founder and managing partner, Moon Pursuit Capital Ahuja said investors should be cautious about assuming the Federal Reserve can ease policy as quickly as markets would like. He will watch the underlying inflation figures alongside the bond market’s reaction, noting that a softer reading could support a recovery in risk appetite. Beyond CPI, analysts are also watching ETF flows and oil-price swings for further clues on where risk appetite, and bitcoin, could head next. The chart shows daily swings in prices for Nymex-listed WTI crude futures. Oil has bounced off the bullish trendline from July lows, reinforcing the broader upward trajectory. On the higher side, the psychological level of $100 and the Sept. 15 high of $106.75 are key numbers to watch. A rally to these levels could add to inflation concerns, potentially weighing on risk assets.

items.article_context_en: The draft budget proposal targets EU-regulated electronic money tokens starting in 2027, reversing France's traditional tax-free crypto-to-crypto stance. France’s legislators introduced a new proposal to expand its 31.4% crypto capital gains tax to include trades involving European Union (EU)-regulated stablecoins, a move Chanalysis warns could drive investors toward stablecoins outside the bloc’s rules. The proposal is part of France's 2027 budget, which lawmakers began debating last week in the National Assembly and have until Dec. An amendment adopted by the National Assembly’s finance committee on Oct. 7 would make it a taxable event when investors exchange cryptocurrencies such as bitcoin for stablecoins classified as electronic money tokens under the EU’s MiCA regulation, which came into full force on July 1. Swapping one crypto for another generally does not trigger capital gains tax in France. The proposed changes would tax swaps into certain EU-regulated stablecoins starting Jan. France currently applies a 31.4% flat tax to crypto gains when investors cash out or spend their holdings. The distinction is critical because the proposal targets a category of stablecoins subject to EU rules, potentially incentivizing traders to use alternatives outside that category. Francois Volpoet, Chainalysis’ regional sales director for France, warned that the measure could undermine efforts to bring more crypto transactions into the regulated financial system. Volpoet said in an email that the proposed tax could push investors toward DeFi platforms, peer-to-peer trading and exchanges outside international tax-reporting arrangements. He said the amendment targets MiCA-compliant stablecoins but may leave other tokens outside its scope. Chainalysis estimates that France reported $9.4 billion in taxable onchain crypto activity in 2025, including $2.5 billion in gains. Volpoet said those numbers do not measure the extent to which trading would be affected by the proposed tax.

items.article_context_en: The bank manages custody and settlement in-house via a closed-loop model, removing the need for separate crypto wallets. The service will initially be available to clients classified as professional investors, and the London-based lender said it is the first of its kind offered by an international bank in the UAE. The debut is also a global first for Standard Chartered, according to the bank, because it marks the first time it has offered cryptocurrency trading directly to wealthy clients in any market. The bank will manage custody and settlement within its own ecosystem using a closed-loop model, it said, meaning clients will not need separate cryptocurrency wallets or third-party trading platforms. The service brings together Standard Chartered’s wealth and retail banking and corporate and investment banking businesses and operates through Zodia Markets, which is backed by the bank’s SC Ventures unit. Standard Chartered said it has received licensing approval from Dubai’s Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority(VARA). The bank introduced institutional bitcoin and ether spot trading through its U.K. arm in July last year and expanded that offering to the UAE on Sept. Standard Chartered already offers eligible clients access to crypto exchange-traded funds (ETFs), structured products and over-the-counter derivatives. It plans to expand the new trading service to other markets, but did not give a timetable in the announcement. Diversified RWA stablecoins sustain 5-7% yield from real credit as crypto funding compresses to ~4%. GENIUS pushes yield off-chain; TAM grows to $4B in 3 years.
